summary: Iteration 1 — full e2e testing of Galaxy Legal (backend + frontend). 24/24 backend pytest tests pass (9 existing unit + 15 new e2e). Anti-fantasma citation validation verified end-to-end: every evidence.quote_excerpt was a case-insensitive whitespace-normalized substring of source texto_extraido and verified=true. Frontend auth, dashboard, case page, tab navigation all work. Two minor frontend issues found: (1) workflow-card-initial_analysis data-testid missing, (2) rendering bug shows literal '${0.0169}' in runs-list cost.

ui_bugs.issue: Broken template literal at CasePage.jsx:160 renders cost as literal string '${0.0169}' instead of '$0.0169'. The source reads `· ${'{'}{Number(r.cost_usd || 0).toFixed(4)}{'}'}` which produces '${N}' as text.

Expected data-testid='workflow-card-initial_analysis' is not present on the workflow card element. The card IS rendered ('Análisis inicial' + Ejecutar button), but the testid hook required by the spec / tests is missing. Add `data-testid={`workflow-card-${w.workflow_type}`}` on the card root.

action_items: Fix CasePage.jsx:160 cost template literal so it renders `$0.0169` not `${0.0169}`. Replace `· ${'{'}{Number(r.cost_usd || 0).toFixed(4)}{'}'}` with `· ${'$'}{Number(r.cost_usd || 0).toFixed(4)}` or simply `· $${Number(r.cost_usd || 0).toFixed(4)}`.
Add data-testid='workflow-card-<workflow_type>' on each workflow card in CasePage.jsx to match the spec/test selector.
Config gap (not a code bug): if magic-link redirect ever fails from the preview URL, ensure Supabase Dashboard → Auth → URL Configuration includes the preview URL in Redirect URLs.
critical_code_review_comments: runs.py workflow version auto-increment is not transactional — if two runs complete concurrently for the same (case, tipo_documento) both may read the same max version and then hit the unique constraint. Consider wrapping in a Postgres function / upsert-with-retry.

documents.py _index_in_background catches all exceptions but only records error in metadata.index_error; there is no UI signal (status column is computed from indexed_at/metadata only). The current mapper correctly derives status='error' when metadata.index_error is set — OK.

CasePage.jsx line 208 still references legacy status 'succeeded' alongside 'completed' in the OK counter; code comment says live schema uses 'completed'. Minor inconsistency — harmless but delete 'succeeded' branch.
drafts.py approve blocks parent_draft_id!=null as an anti-fantasma safeguard. Good. Consider returning 422 instead of 400 since the request is semantically well-formed but state-rejected.

Frontend uses VITE_API_BASE_URL directly; REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env points at a DIFFERENT host (magic-link-preview). It is unused by Vite (VITE_ prefix required). Recommend removing or aligning REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to avoid confusion for future agents.

rca of the issue: CasePage.jsx line 160 bug: the author attempted to escape curly braces in JSX, producing `· ${'{'}{Number(r.cost_usd || 0).toFixed(4)}{'}'}`. JSX evaluates each `{...}` expression: first yields the literal string '{', then the number, then '}'. Result: visible text '${0.0169}'. Correct intent is a dollar sign prefix: `· $${Number(r.cost_usd || 0).toFixed(4)}` (the first '$' is literal JSX text, the second starts the template interpolation — or just use string concat). Reproduction: open any case with a completed run; look at the EJECUCIONES panel (right column). Mitigation: straightforward string fix — see action_items.
